name: plan-labels-cycle-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for `planLabels` (simple tier — the 2D plan editor's furniture-label cycle button in the 'View ▾' menu / mobile Tools sheet). Opens the floor-plan editor, turns on the 'Furniture' footprint layer, verifies NO item labels render pre-cycle (labels default 'off' and nothing is selected), cycles the button off→name (asserts one <text class=plan-item-label> per named item) then name→price (asserts a $-formatted price tspan appears), and re-verifies the cycle button is present after a Simple→Pro switch (planLabels is simple-tier, shown in both modes).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: verify-planlabels-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: planLabels should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: assert-labels-mode-off-baseline
steps.eval: (function(){ const m = window.__store.getState().planLabels; if (m !== 'off') throw new Error('Expected planLabels store mode to start off, got ' + m); })()

steps.name: open-view-menu-for-furniture
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'View ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel && (panel.textContent||'').includes('Furniture')) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('View menu did not show Furniture toggle'); })()

steps.name: click-furniture-toggle
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Furniture'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Furniture' button not found in View menu"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: no-labels-before-select
steps.eval: (function(){ const n = document.querySelectorAll('.plan-item-label').length; if (n !== 0) throw new Error('Expected 0 .plan-item-label elements before selection + with labels off, found ' + n); })()

steps.name: open-view-menu-for-labels-1
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'View ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel && (panel.textContent||'').includes('Labels: off')) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('View menu did not show the Labels: off cycle button'); })()

steps.name: click-labels-cycle-to-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Labels: off'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Labels: off' cycle button not found"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: labels-present-in-name-mode
steps.eval: (function(){ const n = document.querySelectorAll('.plan-item-label').length; if (n === 0) throw new Error('Expected >0 .plan-item-label elements once labels cycle to name'); window.__labelCountName = n; })()

steps.name: open-view-menu-for-labels-2
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'View ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel && (panel.textContent||'').includes('Labels: name')) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('View menu did not show the Labels: name cycle button'); })()

steps.name: click-labels-cycle-to-price
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Labels: name'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Labels: name' cycle button not found"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: price-tspan-present
steps.eval: (function(){ const tspans = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-item-label tspan')]; const priced = tspans.some((t) => /^\$[0-9][0-9,]*$/.test(t.textContent.trim())); if (!priced) throw new Error('Expected at least one $-formatted price tspan once labels cycle to price'); })()

steps.name: verify-planlabels-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: planLabels should still be ON in Pro mode (simple-tier flags are shown in both modes)

steps.name: open-view-menu-pro
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'View ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel && (panel.textContent||'').includes('Labels:')) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('View menu (Pro) did not show a Labels cycle button'); })()
